decisions.reason: This sports flooring system sits outside the firm's stated 2022 focus on style-led interior wood floors and shows no sign of sustained market emphasis after its 2019 launch.

A mobile arena floor is a specialized institutional product with weaker fit to the firm's main customer base and strategy, and its limited website visibility suggests it did not become a core growth line.
This second mobile arena floor appears too peripheral and potentially overlapping for a firm now concentrating resources on trend-oriented residential and architectural flooring.
The chevron hardwood parquet fits the firm's premium design positioning, matches current interior trends, and was prominent enough to be featured on the home page at launch.
The squash court surface finish is a narrow sports niche that does not align well with the firm's direction toward natural, easy-care interior flooring collections.
This oak skirting is tied to the sports-floor segment, so dropping it is consistent with reallocating effort toward the firm's stronger core flooring and design-led product development.
